properties.summary: Members of the public posted 232 times on Bluesky naming "Social Security" with "down" (232) or "outage" (0) in the 6 hours to 01:40 UTC 19 Nov 2026, against a usual of 12.2 for that many hours over the 7 days before. Posts were already over the line in the window's first hour (from 19:40 UTC 18 Nov 2026) and peaked in the hour from 19:40 UTC 18 Nov 2026. Reported by the public on Bluesky and not confirmed by Social Security Administration; Blackout counts the posts and does not read or keep them. Blackout does not assess its cause. A surge can also be news of an outage elsewhere that names the company, a joke, the words in another sense, or the company's own denial (BO-H-7B).
